description:
Every edition of a WSDC event series in the registry (for example each year's US Open),
        most recent first, with the winners (or the top placements) of each division or of one
        division. Also lists other event series that matched the query.

division.description: Only this division, e.g. 'Champions' (default: every division)
division.title: Division

limit.description: Maximum number of editions (years) to return
limit.title: Limit

places.description: Placements to show per division: 1 = winners only
places.title: Places

query.description: Words from the event's name, e.g. 'US Open'
query.title: Query

name: get_event_history

divisions.description: Highest division first; requested placements only
divisions.title: Divisions

editions_total.description: Editions with results in the registry (before limit)
editions_total.title: Editions Total

other_series.description: Other event series that also matched the query
other_series.title: Other Series

series.description: Name of the event series (the most recent edition's name)
series.title: Series

wsdc_event_id.description: WSDC's own ID of the event series
wsdc_event_id.title: Wsdc Event Id

title: Get the history of a WSDC event
